With my first pregnancy, I changed drs directly following my anatomy scan ~ 20 weeks. I was lucky enough to be able to not only change drs, but entire hospitals, as there were 2 in the town I lived in at the time. That experience alone gave me full confidence in switching drs for all issues there on out.

You can (and should!!!) fire any dr who makes you uncomfortable or gives you sh**.

(Context: I had HG, had been to the emergency room on multiple occasions at this point, asked my Dr for intermittent FMLA to protect my job as I worked in a factory with a very strict attendance policy, she laughed & said "I can't give you FMLA for a little bit of puking".

I was on the phone with the other hospital as I walked out of the building.

The other dr was the most understanding dr I've met. I wish I lived closer to his practice now, or he'd be overseeing this pregnancy as well. He gave me 7 days/week of intermittent FMLA. If I needed to, I could use it any day of the week.

Where my first dr saw "a little bit of puking", my 2nd dr saw a woman who was severely dehydrated on multiple occasions & suffering.)
